description:
What banks actually lent to small businesses through the SBA, loan by loan, including loans charged off. Give an address to see loans around it. Returns the true matching count, up to six example rows, and a link to the dataset's documentation.

Example invocations:
- "Which SBA loans went to businesses near 3000 Lyndale Ave S?"
- "How many SBA loans in the metro were charged off?"

address.description: A street address inside the seven-county metro, to answer about ONE property instead of the whole market. Include the city after a comma when the street name is common — 'Grand Ave' exists in several of these cities.

cut.description: all: every approved loan; disbursed: money was disbursed; big: $1m or more; written-off: was charged off. Default all.

within_ft.description: Radius in feet around `address`. Default 5280 (one mile), capped at 26400.

name: sba_loans_nearby
title: SBA Loans Nearby
